name: Brumm
subtitle: the heavy coast
story: Gravity on Brumm is twice ours, so the hills are low, the houses are one storey and nobody owns a ladder. By four, a child is too heavy to carry far. So, in the week they get too heavy, every child gets one Last Carry: the street closes the road, the neighbours come out to cheer, and a parent carries them wherever they choose. Most choose the bakery. Every child on Brumm is asleep by the end.
hook: A planet for everyone who was carried home asleep.
cover: Every child gets one last carry.

episode.opener:
Every child here
gets one last carry.

beats.text:
Gravity here is twice ours.
By four, a child is
too heavy to carry far.

Parents train for four years.
Mostly by carrying them.
Neighbours line the road and cheer.

The child picks where to go.
Most pick the bakery.

Tomas picked the sea,
eight miles away.
His dad made it.

Every child on Brumm
is asleep by the end.

episode.caption:
Keep an eye on the child's arm.

Gravity on Brumm is twice ours, so the hills are low, the houses are one storey and nobody owns a ladder. A four-year-old here weighs what a ten-year-old does on Earth. The Last Carry is a holiday for the child's whole street, held in the week they get too heavy to carry far. The road out of every town has a bench every half mile. The parents don't use them.

I offered to take a turn for a mile. The whole road went quiet. You don't help with a Last Carry. You bring tea.

Tomas is at school now. He says he remembers the sea. His dad says he was asleep by mile six.

On Earth, nobody knows which carry is the last one. On Brumm, everybody does, so they close the road.

Where would you have picked?
